page.title: Alerts

page.title: Watchdog
page.description: Watches the internet link and climbs a recovery ladder when it goes down.
page.unreadableTitle: Could not read the watchdog settings

off.title: Off
off.blurb: The watchdog is not watching the connection.

unknown.title: Unknown
unknown.blurb: The modem is not answering, so we cannot say what the watchdog is doing.

starting.title: Starting
starting.blurb: Just switched on. Waiting for its first report.

not_running.title: Not reporting
not_running.blurb: Switched on, but the watchdog has stopped reporting.

auto_disabled.title: Turned itself off
auto_disabled.blurb: An earlier version switched it off at the reboot limit. Turn it back on once the link is stable.

monitor.title: Watching
monitor.blurb: The link is healthy. Recovery starts after {{time}} offline.

suspect.title: Checking
suspect.blurb: No reply for {{time}}. Recovery starts if it keeps up.
suspect.blurbNow: A check just failed. Confirming before acting.

blurb.outage: Offline for {{time}}. Working through the steps.
blurb.quality: Quality has been poor for {{time}}. Working through the steps.
blurb.carrier: On one carrier for {{time}}. Trying to bring the others back.

next.outage: If the link is still down, step {{tier}} is next.
next.quality: If quality is still poor, step {{tier}} is next.
next.carrier: If it is still on one carrier, step {{tier}} is next.

last.outage: That was the last step. If the link is still down, the watchdog holds off.
last.quality: That was the last step for poor quality. If it persists, the watchdog holds off.
last.carrier: That was the last step for one carrier. If it persists, the watchdog holds off.

outage.title: Holding off for {{time}}
outage.blurb: Every step ran and the link is still down. It starts over at {{time}}.
outage.blurbNow: Every step ran and the link is still down. It starts over shortly.

quality.title: Holding off for {{time}}
quality.blurb: Quality is still poor after every step. It tries again at {{time}}.
quality.blurbNow: Quality is still poor after every step. It tries again shortly.

carrier.title: Holding off for {{time}}
carrier.blurb: Still on one carrier after the steps. It tries again at {{time}}.
carrier.blurbNow: Still on one carrier after the steps. It tries again shortly.

radio_off.title: Radio is off
radio_off.blurb: There is nothing to recover while the radio is off. Watching resumes when it is back on.

ssr_hold.title: Waiting out a modem restart ({{time}})
ssr_hold.blurb: The radio restarted on its own. Recovery waits for it to come back before acting.

ping_stale.title: Connection check is quiet
ping_stale.blurb: The connection check has not reported for a while, so the watchdog is not acting on it.

locked.title: Paused
locked.blurb: Maintenance is in progress, so the watchdog is holding off.

disabled.title: Switched off
disabled.blurb: The service is running but switched off.

tier1.name: Re-register to the network
tier1.consequence: The link drops for a few seconds. The WAN IP may change.

tier2.name: Restart the radio
tier2.consequence: Skipped while a tower lock is active.

tier3.name: Switch to the backup SIM
tier3.consequence: Stays on the backup until you revert.
tier3.consequenceFailback: Switches back to the primary SIM on its own.

tier4.name: Reboot the modem
tier4.hint: At the limit the watchdog stops rebooting and rests until the hour is up. It keeps running the other steps.

failback.name: Switch back to the primary SIM
failback.consequence: Retries the primary SIM. The link drops briefly each try.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: When recovery starts and what sets it off.

down.unknown: Down after the connection check fails

act.label: Start recovery after
act.hint: Recovery never starts before the link counts as down. With {{name}} that takes about {{time}}, so a lower number is raised to it.

quality.label: Recover from poor quality
quality.hint: Counts when replies are slower than {{ms}} ms or more than {{pct}} % are lost. Runs steps 1 and 2 only.
quality.caption: Poor is over {{lat}} or {{loss}}

carrier.label: Recover from one carrier
carrier.hint: Counts only after the modem has used carrier aggregation since it started. Runs steps 1 and 2 only.
carrier.consequence: Step 1 drops the link for a few seconds; the WAN IP may change.

stepWait.label: Wait between steps
stepWait.hint: How long a step gets to work before the link is checked and the next step starts. Never shorter than the link needs to read as up again.

ssr.label: Hold for modem radio restarts
ssr.hint: When the modem restarts its own radio, recovery waits instead of piling on.

timeline.title: If the link drops
timeline.holdoff: Hold off for 15 min, then start over
timeline.off: The watchdog is off, so nothing runs.
timeline.none: No steps are armed, so nothing runs.

activity.title: Recovery Activity
activity.description: What the watchdog has done, newest first.

empty.title: No recovery activity yet
empty.description: Recovery steps and SIM failovers appear here when the watchdog acts on an outage.

row.escalateNext: Moving on to the next step
row.escalateDetail: The last step did not fix it
row.holdoffDetail: Every step ran without a fix
row.ssrHoldDetail: The radio restarted on its own
row.radioPausedDetail: Nothing to recover until it is back on
row.budgetSpentHourly: {{n}} per hour, resting until the hour is up
row.revertBackupFailed: Could not revert, staying on the backup
row.giveupDetail: Revert by hand when you are ready

save.ladderFail: Could not save the recovery ladder

confirmReboot.title: Let the watchdog reboot the modem?
confirmReboot.body: Saving this lets the watchdog reboot the modem on its own when every gentler step has failed. This page goes away for about a minute while the modem comes back.
confirmReboot.cap: Reboots are capped at {{cap}} per hour. At the cap the watchdog rests instead of rebooting again.

errors.backupSlot: Choose a slot to arm this step

failover.title: Running on the backup SIM
failover.body: Switched to slot {{current}} {{since}}. The original SIM is in slot {{original}}.
failover.confirmBody: This switches back to SIM slot {{original}}. Your internet will briefly disconnect while the modem reconnects.
failover.requested: SIM revert requested. The watchdog will process it shortly.
failover.failed: Could not request the SIM revert

page.title: Prometheus
page.description: Let a Prometheus server collect this modem's signal and health readings.

card.title: Prometheus Metrics
card.description: Scraping needs the token below; device identifiers are never included.

endpoint.label: Metrics endpoint
endpoint.consequence_on: Prometheus can read signal, carrier and health readings with the token.

freshness.label: Scrape freshness
freshness.hint: Applies only while Prometheus scrapes at least once a minute. Normal polling resumes two minutes after the last scrape.

consequence.adaptive: Scrapes don't change how often the modem is read.
consequence.balanced: The modem never drops to its slowest polling while Prometheus scrapes.
consequence.realtime: The modem is read every 2 seconds while Prometheus scrapes, like an open dashboard.

facts.adaptive_off: Adaptive polling is off, so readings are always live

token.label: Bearer token
token.consequence: Paste it into Prometheus as the scrape credential.

regenerate_dialog.title: Generate a new token?
regenerate_dialog.description: Prometheus can't scrape until you paste the new token into its config.

config.label: Scrape Config
config.consequence: Add this job to your Prometheus configuration.
config.hint: The modem's certificate is self-signed, so verification is skipped. Over Tailscale, plain http works too.
config.empty_description: Turn on the endpoint and save to get one.

foot.token_on_save: A token is created when you save.
